name: @2lab.ai/beat-ui
description: Beat-synced live-code visuals as zero-dependency TypeScript patterns: an audio-clock scheduler, a score that writes its own code with token ranges, a typewriter that edits like a person, a beat grid and pitch roll, and an ASCII cell sea with spine creatures, a bait ball and a hunt on the drop.

scripts.build:site: npm run build && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:site
